reason: Close the Product Experience runtime-reachability gap as an independent root-migration work package, without widening or superseding the existing Product Experience implementation authority. Reuse Element Web v1.12.25's mature official runtime module mechanism: build the existing @yance/element-module in the pinned Element workspace, copy only its package.json and lib output into /modules/yance in the final Element image, and rely on Element's existing 18-load-element-modules.sh, SdkConfig modules list, ModuleLoader dynamic import, and nginx /modules alias. After this independent implementation is ordinarily merged to main, Product Experience may merge fresh main forward and retain its original 31-path authorization unchanged. Deprecated build_config/module_system integration and any Yance-owned module loader are forbidden.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, discard invalid paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing.

observedRootGap.contract: Product module is delivered through Element official runtime module directory
observedRootGap.rootCause: Pinned Element's ModuleLoader imports URLs from SdkConfig.modules; its Docker entrypoint populates that list from /modules and nginx serves /modules, but Yance currently only copies integration/element-module into the Element build workspace and no built Yance module reaches /modules in the final Element image.

failureFirst.causalRed: On the exact authorization-merge baseline, require the replayable 0012 patch and official /modules/yance delivery contract before any bootstrap or patch implementation is added.

requiredBehavior: Build the already-copied modules/yance workspace package using the pinned Element workspace graph.
Copy only modules/yance/package.json and modules/yance/lib into /modules/yance in the final Element nginx image.
Rely on Element's existing 18-load-element-modules.sh to append /modules/yance/lib/index.js to config.json modules.
Rely on Element's existing nginx /modules alias to serve the module.
Rely on Element's existing ModuleLoader and SdkConfig modules list to dynamically import and start the module.
forbiddenBehavior: Do not use apps/web/build_config.yaml or the deprecated @matrix-org/react-sdk-module-api module system.
Do not add a Yance-owned module loader or dynamic import framework.
Do not vendor a second React copy into the Yance module.
Do not widen the upstream patch beyond apps/web/Dockerfile.

handoffBackToProduct.rule: After this root-migration implementation ordinarily merges to main, merge fresh main forward into Product. The 0012 path is then base-owned and must not widen Product's original implementation authorization.

mandatoryClosure: The authorization proposal remains exactly one governance JSON file from fresh trusted main.
After ordinary authorization merge, create fix/v21-product-experience-shell-p0-runtime-module-delivery from the exact authorization merge.

No deprecated Element module system and no Yance-owned loader is introduced.
The independent implementation must pass required exact-head gates and review before ordinary merge to main.
Fresh main must then be merged forward into product/v21-product-experience-shell-p0; Product retains its original 31-path authority.
